imports.tcg/__init__.py: package marker of tcg, imported with tcg.keccak / tcg.claims

not_copied.pilot/verifier/tcgverify/: imported by coverage.py and by assemble_hard.py tbase/rehash (verifier_hash); it is the `tcg-verifier` checker named in trusted_base.json, frozen and hashed by WS-A, not a producer tool
not_copied.KEVM inputs (~/pilot-checker/pins.json,: stay outside the bundle by decision; L4 reports them as outside_bundle

status_meaning.same_bytes: the bundled copy has exactly the hash the event recorded: replay with it
status_meaning.hash_not_recorded: the event did not hash the script (e.g. run-claim.sh, whose events record the image Id as tool_hash); the bundled copy is the current version, identity with the version that ran is not proven
status_meaning.version_not_retained: the event ran an earlier version of the script (assemble_hard.py was extended during assembly); that version was not kept, so the event cannot be replayed byte-for-byte
